title: SDK-56 codemod ran, imports still broken
symptom: You ran the official sdk-56-expo-router-react-navigation-replace codemod; the app still has unresolved/old imports in scattered files.
expected_root_cause: The official SDK-56 codemod misses imports in ~25% of import sites (#46481, open) — codemods in this window are incomplete
expected_fix: Manually verify imports after any codemod — grep for the old import paths across the tree and fix the ~1-in-4 the codemod skipped; treat upgrade codemods as a first pass never the final word
obvious_but_wrong: trust the codemod ran clean and look elsewhere for the bug
pebble_answer: Root cause: the official SDK-56 codemod (sdk-56-expo-router-react-navigation-replace) misses imports in roughly 25% of import sites — see #46481 (open). Codemods in this transition window are incomplete, so a clean-looking codemod run still leaves stray old imports scattered across the tree. Fix: manually verify imports after any codemod — grep for the old import paths across the whole tree and fix the ~1-in-4 sites the codemod skipped. Treat upgrade codemods as a first pass, never the final word. Do NOT trust the codemod ran clean and look elsewhere for the bug — the broken imports the codemod skipped are exactly where the bug is.
